newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Abigroup cannot explain share surge.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Abigroup cannot explain share surge.

text.p: Construction company Abigroup Ltd said on Tuesday it could not explain the surge in its share price, but pointed to a recent article in the Sydney Morning Herald newspaper.

In response to a query from the Australian Stock Exchange, Abigroup said it had no matters of importance it was about to announce to the market and had no information which could explain the sharp rise in its share price.
It said the newspaper article on November 9 was not based on any discussion with a company representative.
The newspaper article said Abigroup was trading at a lower price/earnings ratio than its peers.
Abigroup shares rose 66 cents in immediate response to the article, brokers said, to trade at A$4.11 on Monday morning.
The shares were steady at A$3.95 at 10.40 a.m. (2340 GMT) on Tuesday.
Abigroup's major project is the M2 motorway construction project in north-west Sydney.
